name: provian-icloud-documents
description: iCloud ubiquity-container file store for the PE backup (iCloud.com.provian.wallet, PEBackup/): coordinated atomic writes, on-demand downloads, and a metadata query for restore on a fresh phone. The files are already AES-256-GCM ciphertext when they arrive here. iOS only; Android backs up to Drive appDataFolder through ProvianCloudKeychainSync.
